'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***More than a dozen explosions are reported in [[Kyiv]] as [[Russia]] launches a [[missile]] barrage at the capital and other [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] cities. [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] say that they have shot down six [[Kh-47M2 Kinzhal]] [[Hypersonic weapon|hypersonic missiles]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/3a3ea049-699f-4f92-8b5e-d0aba9023dce (''Financial Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/air-defence-systems-repelling-attacks-ukraine-early-tuesday-officials-2023-05-16/ (Reuters)]
***The [[Ministry of Defense (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defense]] claims that it destroyed a [[MIM-104 Patriot|Patriot air defense system]] in Kyiv. However a [[United States]] official says that the system was likely damaged but not destroyed. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/16/politics/patriot-missile-damage-ukraine/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Herder–farmer conflicts in Nigeria]]
**[[2023 Mangu violence]]
***At least 80 people are killed by armed attackers during a [[Spree killer|shooting spree]] on several villages in [[Plateau State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-violence-killings-shooting-plateau-herdsmen-fulani-043596ecac029a7b5603cb3a0513732b (AP)]
*Nine people are arrested after an alleged [[Iran]]ian-backed [[coup d'état]] plot is uncovered in [[Azerbaijan]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/azerbaijan-makes-arrests-over-fresh-coup-plot-blamed-on-iran-bde2f604 (''Barron's'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**The death toll from [[Cyclone Mocha]]'s landfall in [[Myanmar]], increases to 81 people. The majority of casualties and damage occurred in the [[Rakhine State]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/cyclone-mocha-death-toll-rises-81-myanmar-3493731 (CNA)]
*[[Wellington hostel fire]]
**Six people are killed and eleven others are reported missing in a fire at a hostel in [[Wellington]], [[New Zealand]]. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/wellington-fire-people-unaccounted-for-after-large-fire-breaks-out-at-hostel/TNAKNGVQDVH3VLGWNTAE7B5OEA/ (NZ Herald)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Ukraine–NATO relations]]
**[[Ukraine]] officially joins [[NATO]]'s [[Cooperative Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence]]. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2023/05/16/7402456/ (Ukrainska Pravda)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Namibia]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Namibia]] recognises foreign [[same-sex marriage]]s between citizens. However, [[homosexual acts]] remain illegal in [[Namibia]] under a rarely enforced colonial-era law from 1927. [https://www.macaubusiness.com/namibia-recognises-same-sex-marriages-concluded-abroad-with-foreign-spouse/ (AFP via ''Macau Business'')]
*[[Portugal|Portuguese]] [[President of Portugal|President]] [[Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa]] signs a law [[Legality of euthanasia|legalizing]] [[euthanasia]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/portugal-president-signs-law-legalising-euthanasia (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')] [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1770415/out-of-vetoes-portugal-president-enacts-law-allowing-euthanasia (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[impeachment]] trial against [[Ecuadorian president]] [[Guillermo Lasso]] begins, with Lasso attending in person for his defense. [https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-lasso-impeachment-proceedings-da875da1af0e46af370d0706fdabd49a (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
